text:
```yaml
name: Close Old Bot Discussions
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  discussions: write

jobs:
  close-old-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go install github.com/githubnext/gh-aw/cmd/gh-aw@latest

      - name: Close old bot discussions
        run: |
          gh-aw close-old-discussions \
            --token=${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} \
            --repo=${{ github.repository }} \
            --days=30 \
            --label="bot" \
            --message="This discussion has been automatically closed due to inactivity. If you have any further questions or need assistance, please open a new discussion."

      - name: Create comment on closed discussions
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          issue-number: ${{ steps.close-discussions.outputs.closed-discussions }}
          body: |
            This discussion has been automatically closed due to inactivity. If you have any further questions or need assistance, please open a new discussion.
```
